Madras High Court suggests 'househusbands' to preserve marriages

The Madurai Bench of the Madras High Court has suggested that husbands could become homemakers to help preserve marriages and families, observing that the increasing number of women pursuing careers is taking a toll on marital relationships. The court made this observation while dissolving a matrimonial dispute and calling for an equitable division of domestic duties. The suggestion was reported by The New Indian Express.
